title: Brother's tin flute and the Rene brothers
summary: Sidney started on a tin flute then clarinet; Arthur's mother raised Kid Rene and his brother Joseph lodging at the house.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: He started off with a little tin flute with six holes in it. Then he got one flute he used to blow from the side with six holes. Then he got so good on that, he turns around and he buys him a clarinet. Then there was a fella by the name of Rene. Oh, yeah, Kid Rene.
Kid Rene and his brother Joseph.

I knew, Joseph still living. Still living. Well, Joseph at that time was a clarinet player in them days. But I don't know if anything happened to his mouth or his troth, but he turned out to be a drummer. Yeah.
Right? He belongs to a church now and plays.
Still plays up there, the Jehovah's Witnesses.

Well, my mother partly raised those two boys. Oh, really? They rented a little room upstairs in the back of our house. My mother rented them. But their mama and their dad was always working and my mother used to feed them and everything. Now, Kid Rene, she was responsible for him making his first communion. Yeah. We had rent their mother a room. Well, I was going to ask, Paul, I think about your family some more.
